messages:
kyle: quick heads up -- noticed console preview showing rows from another workspace when rapidly switching orgs :eyes:
sasha: repro steps? browser / quick switch flow or API-level?
maria: saw this too on staging. cause looks like prefetch service returning cached HTML fragment tied to a sticky route header.
ajay: do you have any logs? I wonder if the route affinity header (X-Route-Affinity) is being treated as tenant scoping instead of affinity-only.
kyle: pasted logs, minimal:
```
2026-03-18T21:13:04Z prefetch req id=abc123 host=console.prefetch X-Route-Affinity=zone-a X-Tenant="t-42"
2026-03-18T21:13:04Z cache GET key=fragment:preview:zone-a -> HIT owner=t-17
```
maria: exactly. cache key omitted the real tenant id in some fast-switch paths, so fragments got reused across tenants.
sasha: ugh. that also explains weird quota attribution we saw where token usage spiked on tenant t-17 even though UI users were on t-42. telemetry attribution used fragment owner header for billing.
ajay: two problems: (1) cache key composition bug, (2) telemetry/backfill relying on fragment owner header as source-of-truth. both are leaking customer data and wrong billing.
kyle: any quick mitigation? we should kill prefetch on prod right away for affected route or patch cache key server-side.
maria: proposal: feature-flag prefetch on the rollout UX; immediate hotfix = change cache lookup to require explicit X-Tenant header plus request id. fallback to MISS if absent.
sasha: can we also add a guard to telemetry: if fragment owner != request X-Tenant then mark event as suspect and divert to quarantine bucket (no billing) until investigated?
ajay: yes. quick checklist:
- stop prefetch (ff) for /runs preview in prod (maria)
- patch cache key logic to include tenant id + session id (ajay)
- telemetry quarantine + alert on mismatch (sasha)
- add e2e test that simulates rapid org switch (kyle)
- audit historical events for cross-tenant attribution window (maria)

maria: I'll open PR for ff + cache key change, target hotfix branch. adding tests.
kyle: I'll write the repro harness and smoke test for the rollout pipeline.
sasha: I'll own telemetry quarantine and write a quick dataplane query to find suspect events in the last 48h.
ajay: heads up deploy-bot shows a canary rolled 10m ago in prefetch service (likely culprit):
deploy-bot: canary-deploy prefetch-service sha=0f4b2a -> env=prod-zone-a status=success ts=2026-03-18T21:03:00Z
kyle: ok revert or ff until patch merged. this is high-sev because of data bleed + billing. can someone escalate to security/compliance?
maria: pinging sec and compliance now. i'll also draft a customer-facing note template.
sasha: adding postmortem checklist item: don't use affinity headers as tenant scoping, always assert explicit tenant context at cache boundaries.
ajay: +1. will land patch in hotfix and cut a rollback FF if deploy shows more hits.
kyle: thanks team. low-verbosity channel update: I'll post an incident stub in #incidents after we confirm scope. :thumbsup:
